title: Compact exhaustion of an open subset of ℝ^P
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)) be open. Then there is a sequence (K_i)_{i∈ℕ} of compact subsets of ℝ^P such that K_i ⊆ U for every i ∈ ℕ, and every compact set C ⊆ ℝ^P with C ⊆ U is contained in K_i for some i ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), (∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) ∧ (∀ i, K i ⊆ U) ∧ ∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → ∃ i, C ⊆ K i
